title: Holographic two-point functions of heavy operators revisited
summary: In this paper we investigate the holographic computation of the two-point functions of $\frac{1}{2}$-BPS chiral primary operators with scaling dimensions $Δ\sim N$ or $Δ\sim N^2$ in $\mathcal{N}=4$ $SU(N)$ SYM using Type IIB supergravity. First we consider giant graviton operators, resolving ambiguities in the previous literature on holographic computation of the two-point function, and make a new proposal for this calculation.
